CAS — 34784-64-0 (tertatolol); 33580-30-2 (tertatolol hydrochloride). ATC — C07AA16. ATC Vet — QC07AA16. (tertatolol) Profile Tertatolol is a non-cardioselective beta blocker (p.1225). It is re- ported to lack intrinsic sympathomimetic activity. Tertatolol is given orally as the hydrochloride in the management of hypertension (p.1171) in a dose of 5 mg tertatolol hydrochlo- ride once daily, increased to 10 mg once daily if required.
